_note: Nifty 50 derivative lot sizes from NSE circulars. A contract's lot depends on its (cycle, expiry date): first_weekly_expiry / first_monthly_expiry are the first expiries WITH that lot (taken from each circular). effective_from is the first trade date of the new lot (date-only lookups inside the transition window are ambiguous on purpose). Approved by the user after checking NSE/FAOP/61415 on nseindia.com. Not modelled: quarterly/half-yearly contracts already listed at a changeover switch on their own EOD date (26 Dec 2024, 30 Dec 2025).

rows.source: NSE/FAOP/47854, Circular Ref. 28/2021, 31 Mar 2021 (75 -> 50): https://archives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/FAOP47854.pdf. Unchanged by NSE/FAOP/56233 (Circular 62/2023, 31 Mar 2023, NIFTY 50 -> 50).
NSE/FAOP/61415, Circular Ref. 37/2024, 2 Apr 2024 (50 -> 25; the 25 Apr 2024 monthly keeps 50): https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/FAOP61415.pdf
NSE/FAOP/64625, Circular Ref. 128/2024, 18 Oct 2024 (25 -> 75; last 25: weekly 19 Dec 2024, monthly 30 Jan 2025): https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/FAOP64625.pdf
